decision: Accept this exact unmodified Union A west contact/casualty pair for the bounded opt-in v21 source pilot, using the independently registered support pivots and a shared 365-pixel reference. No source-blocking defect was found. Aim-like lunge/rear-grip occlusion, cross-family animation scale and low-alpha edge appearance remain explicit renderer-review limits.
scope: Two complete 1254-square RGBA native 2x2 sources, four contact endpoints and four non-graphic casualty endpoints; no source pixels, historical source or runtime files changed.
bearingAndKit: All visible profiles and weapons face image left; the lying body retains its head and rifle muzzle to the left. The navy cap/coat, pale blue trousers, brown boots, buff straps, dark pack, tan blanket roll and round canteen match Union A. The illustrative material finish is compatible with the Confederate v20 pair, with side-specific colors and naturally different fall poses.
scaleAssessment: The contact poses retain coherent head/limb/boot and kit proportions despite braced posture changes. A 365-pixel common reference gives calculated contact cap-to-sole extents of approximately 33.84,30.51,31.30,32.70 pixels at a 32-pixel target reference. These are image arithmetic, not measured renderer output. The naturally shortened casualty silhouettes are not enlarged to standing height; ordinary/close gameplay comparison remains required.

measurementContract.method: Inspect the complete native sheets and all eight 627-pixel native cell views. Manually select projected pelvic/support X positions from the visible anatomical leg/hip/support structure, excluding pack, canteen and musket. For the four contact cells select cap-crown-only and nearer rear/right supporting-sole-only ROIs. At alpha>=64 recompute cap minY and sole maxYExclusive, yielding body spans [386,348,357,373]. Their median is 365; round half upward to one referenceHeight=365 and apply it unchanged across both complete sources. Ground Y is independently recomputed from each role-appropriate support ROI. Coordinates and ROIs are native cell-local pixels, with exclusive right/bottom ROI edges. No body-box centering, phase scale normalization, casualty height normalization, raster resampling, mirroring, alpha repair, warping or synthesized intermediate pose is approved.
measurementContract.source: contact alone determines the common human reference
measurementContract.nativeCoordinateConvention: Cell-local pixels; row-major order. ROIs [x0,y0,x1,y1] use exclusive right/bottom edges. Ground Y is maxYExclusive of alpha>=64 pixels inside the anatomical support ROI.

limitations: This is independent model-assisted source inspection, not human art, usability, historical-drill or physical-anatomy certification.

The level lunge still resembles shouldered aim in isolation and its rear grip is partly occluded. The source does not establish exact two-hand thrust mechanics; actual opposing-contact playback must establish useful action readability before installation.

Native stance and joint changes are visible, especially low recovery versus high block, but still frames do not prove temporal smoothness, weight transfer, musket-length continuity or complete hand/finger mechanics.

Projected pelvis/support X positions are manually interpreted illustration registrations, not physical bone, joint or center-of-mass measurements. The oblique support plane does not require every extremity to share one image Y.

Contact cap-to-sole spans range by 38/365, about 10.41 percent, because these are braced/lunging/bent poses. Historical stationary-source 5/6 percent rules are not applied, and natural posture differences are not normalized away.

All casualty poses use the same contact-derived 365-pixel reference. Kneeling and lying height reductions are intentional; relative head/limb/boot and equipment proportions were judged visually, not anatomically certified.

Alpha>=64 silhouette margins are at least 36 pixels in contact and 56 in casualty. Very low-alpha colored noise remains, including some cell-edge pixels. Complete edge/fringe freedom is not certified; source pixels remain unchanged.

The Union A v9 source and Confederate v20 pair were viewed as kit/style/scale references. This does not inherit their source approvals or certify cross-family playback equality; both sides must be compared in the actual renderer at ordinary and close scale.
Inspection-only native cell crops were written outside the candidate without resampling. They are diagnostic views and are not exported or substituted for the complete original PNGs.

Acceptance covers only these two exact source sheets and registrations. Integration, exporter output, complete-action fallback, renderer continuity, pause/cold resume, reduced motion, GPU/ordinary-PC behavior, complete family, default art and local installation require separate checks.
